privacyText: Chida ichi chimagwiritsa ntchito mautumiki a AI ochokera kwa ena pokonza mafunso a ogwiritsa ntchito. Zokambirana zimafufutidwa mukachoka patsambali. Chonde musatumize zinthu zachinsinsi kapena zomwe zingadziwitse munthu.
aboutDescription: Chidachi chinapangidwa ndi Yahya Qanie, mothandizidwa ndi Lena Slachmuijlder ndi Saji Prelis a Search for Common Ground; chitukuko chaukadaulo chinatsogoleredwa ndi Murtaza Qanie. Chinapangidwa kuti chidziwitso cha ndondomeko ya Achinyamata, Mtendere ndi Chitetezo—yokhazikitsidwa pa Chigamulo 2250 cha Bungwe la Chitetezo la United Nations—chikhale chosavuta kupeza komanso kulimbikitsa kayendetsedwe ka YPS pakati pa mabungwe, akatswiri ndi opanga mfundo.
aboutSourcesDescription: Chida ichi chakhazikitsidwa pazidziwitso zosungidwa bwino zomwe zikuphatikiza zisankho ndi zomangira za UN, zofalitsa za UN, zolemba za mabungwe achigawo, mapulani ndi njira zadziko, kafukufuku wamaphunziro, ndi zofalitsa zochokera ku mabungwe aboma ndi mabungwe omwe si aboma.
starter1: Fotokozerani mwachidule ndandanda ya Achinyamata, Mtendere ndi Chitetezo
starter2: Kodi njira zabwino zophatikizirapo achinyamata popanga zisankho ndi ziti?
starter3: Perekani malingaliro a mapulojekiti omanga mtendere m'madera a ku Central Asia.
starter4: Kodi magawo opangira mapulani a National Action Plan ndi ati?
